issue.title: Stabilize artifact-file facade tests under full-suite load
issue.description: During required verification for the code-swap guard work on 2026-08-02, full 'just check' passed all lint and validation stages, then failed pytest with exactly two artifact-file facade nodes after 25,535 passes / 7 skips: tests/artifact_file_facade/test_reclaim.py::test_clean_pushed_file_reclaims_resolves_and_is_idempotent and tests/artifact_file_facade/test_vcs.py::test_materialize_artifact_file_uses_verified_content_cache. Both nodes passed immediately afterward when rerun directly with '.venv/bin/python -m pytest <two nodes> -q' (2 passed in 1.98s), so this appears to be xdist/full-suite load or order sensitivity rather than a deterministic regression in the code-swap lock changes. Reproduce under full-suite or targeted parallel load, identify the shared artifact-file cache/reclaim state leak or timing dependency, and make the tests deterministic without weakening their VCS cache/reclaim guarantees.

evidence.note: Independent recurrence during unrelated _registry_scan module split verification on 2026-08-03: a 28-worker full just check failed the exact two tracked artifact-file facade nodes after 25,823 passes / 7 skips. Both nodes passed immediately in a serial focused rerun (0.13s reclaim, 0.07s materialization), matching the full-suite load/order sensitivity.

Independent reproduction during the sase-ez epic land audit on 2026-08-03 at HEAD 943ffd0d3. Full 'just check' passed every static gate (fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, changelog, symvision, toobig, SASE validation, committed plans) and then failed pytest on exactly the same two nodes after 25,774 passes / 7 skips: tests/artifact_file_facade/test_reclaim.py::test_clean_pushed_file_reclaims_resolves_and_is_idempotent and tests/artifact_file_facade/test_vcs.py::test_materialize_artifact_file_uses_verified_content_cache. Both passed immediately on isolated rerun ('.venv/bin/python -m pytest <two nodes> -p no:randomly -q' -> 2 passed in 2.04s). Four other agent workspaces were running full suites concurrently, so this recurs under host-level contention and is not specific to the code-swap guard change that first reported it.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05: consolidating the full-parallel-suite / xdist flake class onto umbrella task sase-ct ('Flaky ACE TUI tests under full parallel just test run'). Every one of these reports the same shape — a single node fails under the full four-to-27-worker 'just test' or 'just check' run and passes immediately in isolation — so they share a root-cause class (xdist load sensitivity and shared-state leakage across workers) rather than per-test logic bugs. Per-test detail, including sase-cu's pump-free clipboard-task diagnosis, stays readable on each bead, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them if a specific node turns into a deterministic failure.
